total-revenue: SELECT SUM(total_cents)/100.0 FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'
revenue-by-country: SELECT c.country, SUM(o.total_cents)/100.0 FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY 2 DESC
orders-sold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'
average-order: SELECT AVG(total_cents)/100.0 FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'
net-revenue: SELECT (SELECT SUM(total_cents) FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid')/100.0 - (SELECT SUM(amount_cents) FROM refunds)/100.0
top-customer: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total_cents)/100.0 FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1
revenue-germany: SELECT SUM(o.total_cents)/100.0 FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND c.country = 'DE'
buyers: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'
largest-order: SELECT MAX(total_cents)/100.0 FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'
march-revenue: SELECT SUM(total_cents)/100.0 FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND placed_at BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31'
